subject: Architect-focused lightning session — RSVP nudge sequence & tracking map
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: architect lightning session invite + RSVP nudge plan

Team — putting this one in your review queue. We're running a 30-minute "Architect Lightning" livestream aimed squarely at platform/infra architects who are evaluating inference architecture (short, technical, demo-lite). Goals: collect qualified RSVPs (engineer/architect role), route top prospects to AE for follow-up, and minimize no-shows with a 3-touch nudge sequence.

Key asks from you:
- Copy: two subject-line variants and two body-length variants (short vs expanded).
- Target list: confirm segment filters in the attached CSV (I prefiltered for infra/platform titles & infra SaaS companies > $20M).
- Tracking: validate UTM matrix in the attached spreadsheet and the final calendar link.

Draft subject options (short):
1) "Architect Lightning: 30m — Practical LLM serving patterns"
2) "Live: Architect session on predictable LLM inference"

CTA treatment (primary): RSVP -> calendar + HubSpot form (one-click). Secondary: "Request an on-call demo" internal CTA for high-value companies.

Nudge cadence (proposed):
- Day 0: Invite (send)
- Day 3: Reminder 1 (short, subject: "Quick reminder — Architect session")
- Day 6: Reminder 2 (social proof + speaker highlight)
- Day 1 pre-event: Day-before reminder (calendar + one-sentence agenda)
- Day 0 1-hour: 1-hr heads up (very short)

UTM matrix: using source=email, medium=webinar, campaign=arch-lightning-may27, content=variant1/variant2. See utm_matrix_v1.xlsx.

Attachments: audience_list_engineers.csv (segment), invite_designer_v3.png (hero), utm_matrix_v1.xlsx

I plan to send the first batch to the top-250 priority accounts (ACME included) on Tue May 18 at 9am PT if we lock copy by EOD Monday.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Growth Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: architect lightning session invite + RSVP nudge plan

Thanks — love the tight scope. A few quick edits and suggestions inline:

- Subject tweaks (use these A/B):
  A) "Architect Lightning: Practical LLM serving patterns — May 27" (explicit date helps opens)
  B) "How top infra teams cut LLM inference costs — 30m live" (results-oriented)

- Body (short): keep header, 2 bullets for what they'll learn, 1-sentence speaker cred, then RSVP CTA. Example short body: "Join our 30-minute Architect Lightning session where Redwood engineers break down practical serving patterns that reduce token costs and improve p99 latency. Speakers: Mateo Alvarez (Staff SWE, Redwood) + Martin Lee (infra lead, partner). RSVP now → [calendar link]."

- Long body: add a tiny agenda (5m context, 10m patterns, 10m config tradeoffs, 5m Q&A) + one customer quote line.

- Target list: Confirming the CSV looks good; suggestion to add a boolean column for "in-field-engaged" (recent product trial or demo) so we can prioritize follow-up.

- UTM: add "audience=architects" param and set content to variant id (e.g., content=shortA). Also track a hidden link on the RSVP button for click-throughs.

- Nudge copy ideas:
  Reminder 1 (Day 3): "Still seats left — Architect Lightning (May 27)"
  Reminder 2 (Day 6): "Speakers added + short case study: how Acme AI cut p99 by 30%"
  Day-before: calendar + 1-line agenda
  1-hr: "Ready? Join here" with join link

Small ask: can design produce a 600x200 hero and a plain-text-safe .png? The hero in invite_designer_v3.png is close; prefer a 600x200 and a 600x120 fallback.

I'll be out Mon morning but can do a quick pass Mon lunch.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Demand, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
